choices.label: Store on device
choices.description: Keep preferences on Cody and restore them after a restart.

choices.label: Sync to PC
choices.description: Save preferences on this computer and sync them to Cody when connected. The computer keeps a copy, so the same preferences can be restored after a device replacement.

choices.label: Keep this session only
choices.description: Keep preferences only for this session. Discard them when the session ends.

proposal_change: At most two full-width numbered single-line choices per viewport; further choices replace the visible pair through swiping. Buttons have no icons; the lateral Back chevron remains. Selection opens numbered full text, and only Send commits. Native approvals stay on the PC.
terminal_states: Offline preserves identity and original deadline. Expired, cancelled or cleared requests never select an answer. Sent-but-unacknowledged remains unconfirmed. Completion notices never replace an open question.

screens.title: Another chat has replied
screens.note: A background reply is ready. Current work stays visible.

screens.title: A chat needs your answer
screens.note: An amber notice names the chat and the pending count.

screens.title: Choose the pending chat
screens.note: Two pending chats. Opening one preserves followed activity.

screens.title: Answers 1 and 2
screens.note: Two original choices. Swipe for more; tap to read in full.

screens.title: Scroll to answer 3
screens.note: The next page replaces the pair. No free-text answer.

screens.title: Read, then send
screens.note: Number + original label and description. Tap or swipe text.

screens.title: Wait for the recipient
screens.note: One fixed answer. Sending is not proof of receipt.

screens.title: Reply received
screens.note: Show only after the matching acknowledgement. One remains.
